title: Early Medieval Spain: Unity in Diversity, 400–1000
usage: Roman-Visigothic transition, Arab conquest of 711, Christian realms; critique of 711 as a clean rupture.
notes: Second revised edition; DOI verified via SpringerLink. Standard synthesis, not a primary source.

title: Late Roman Spain and Its Cities
usage: Roman Hispania, urban continuity, the end of Roman rule and the Visigothic settlement.
notes: Project MUSE DOI; original 2004 monograph; the DOI points to the 2011 edition.

title: Muslim Spain and Portugal: A Political History of al-Andalus
usage: Political history of al-Andalus from 711 to the Nasrid kingdom; Umayyad, taifa, Almoravid and Almohad periods.
notes: Original Longman 1996; the DOI points to the 2014 Routledge reissue.

title: Beyond convivencia: critical reflections on the historiography of interfaith relations in Christian Spain
usage: Critique of the idealized convivencia model; interfaith coexistence and violence in medieval Iberia.
notes: Peer-reviewed article; author has also published on Jews and Christians in medieval Castile.

title: After Expulsion: 1492 and the Making of Sephardic Jewry
usage: Expulsion of the Jews, Sephardic diaspora, memory and identity after 1492.
notes: Original 2013; the DOI points to the 2020 edition.

title: The Expulsion of the Moriscos from Spain: A Mediterranean Diaspora
usage: Morisco expulsion of 1609–1614, diaspora, royal policy and local implementation.
notes: Edited scholarly volume; chapters peer-reviewed.

title: La gran redada de gitanos: España, la prisión general de gitanos en 1749
usage: General arrest of Roma ordered on 30 July 1749; legal persecution and its implementation.
notes: Specialist monograph; ISBN 84-87347-09-6 verified via Dialnet and NYPL; no DOI.

title: Imperial Spain 1469–1716
usage: Habsburg and Bourbon Spain, empire, Comuneros, Armada, Nueva Planta, court and economy.
notes: Classic synthesis first published in 1963; 2002 Penguin edition with a new preface.

title: Deadly Embrace: Morocco and the Road to the Spanish Civil War
usage: Spanish colonial wars in Morocco, the Army of Africa and the roots of the 1936 coup.
notes: Oxford Scholarship Online monograph.

title: War and Genocide in Cuba, 1895–1898
usage: Cuban war of independence, Spanish reconcentration policy, 1898 and the end of the American empire.
notes: Peer-reviewed monograph; UNC Press page and ISBN verified.

title: Modern Spain: 1808 to the Present
usage: Political and social synthesis from 1808 to 2016: liberalism, labour, women, transition, ETA, emigration.
notes: Wiley monograph; comprehensive synthesis with a strong social-history dimension.

title: Anarchists of Andalusia, 1868–1903
usage: Rural anarchism, peasant protest and CNT prehistory in southern Spain.
notes: Original 1977; the DOI points to the 2015 Princeton reissue.

title: The Spanish Republic and Civil War
usage: Second Republic, women's suffrage, Civil War, political violence and the Francoist victory.
notes: CUP monograph translated from Spanish.

title: The Spanish Holocaust: Inquisition and Extermination in Twentieth-Century Spain
usage: Francoist repression, civil-war violence, exile and the politics of memory.
notes: Controversial title but scholarly monograph; LSE repository record and ISBN 978-0-00-255634-7 verified.

title: Memory and Amnesia: The Role of the Spanish Civil War in the Transition to Democracy
usage: Transition to democracy, memory of the Civil War, amnesty and forgetting.
notes: Translated from Spanish; Berghahn monograph.

title: L'Exil des républicains espagnols en France: De la Guerre civile à la mort de Franco
usage: Retirada of 1939, French internment camps, Republican exile and transnational memory.
notes: French reference work; ISBN 978-2-226-10721-5 verified via the Archives départementales de la Corrèze.

title: Democracy Reloaded: Inside Spain's Political Laboratory from 15-M to Podemos
usage: 15-M movement, Indignados, social movements and the political recomposition after 2011.
notes: OUP monograph; participant-observer research.

title: Catalonia: The Struggle Over Independence
usage: Catalan nationalism, autonomy, the 2010 Statute crisis, the 2017 referendum and its aftermath.
notes: OUP monograph; 2022 edition.

title: Economic Valuation of Environmental Damages due to the Prestige Oil Spill in Spain
authors: Maria L. Loureiro; John B. Loomis; Maria Xosé Vázquez
usage: Environmental and economic damage of the Prestige oil spill (November 2002), Galician coast.
notes: Peer-reviewed environmental economics article.

title: Ley 20/2022, de 19 de octubre, de Memoria Democrática
usage: 2022 memory law: victim recognition, Valley of the Fallen, symbolic and legal measures.
notes: Primary legal source; consolidated text on BOE.
